en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Amro Bin Usman, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Rabat, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘The Prophetsaww said to Sa’ad Bin Ubada that Allahazwj Made a Penalty (Hadd) for everything, and Made a Penalty (Hadd) to be upon everyone who transgresses a Limit (Hadd) from the Limits of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, and Made what was less than the four witnesses as a veil upon the Muslims’.
